title: 第14章 风城往事十四第15章 风城往事十五
slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
两个月后。
刘家摘星楼。
“你听说没，半个月前苏磊在天宝阁高价买了一枚疗伤丹药，那花的钱老多了，都够我几辈子花了。”
“看到没，这才叫土壕。”
“嘿，依我看啊这苏家可能要完了。”
“别瞎说，苏家如今如日中天，怎么可能说完就完。”
“嘿，你别不信啊，我告诉你，我邻居家二妹子的大表哥他爹的远房大侄子的表妹的干哥哥在苏家当看门狗，呸，看门护卫，他和我说呀，这苏家三天前就开始疏散了一众下人，表面上是为了祝贺苏少卿去了玄天门，特意给放了假，但实际上，是苏磊身患重病，命不久矣啊。”
“啊，不是吧，这怎么可能啊。”
“哎呀，兄弟，你要相信这个世界上万事万物都有可能会发生。”
“那你说，你有没有下一秒就会死的可能。”一双手搭在了那个男人肩膀上。
“嗨，兄弟，这你不是瞎说吗，我怎么可能下一秒就死呢。”那人转头看了眼来人，登时便跪了下来。
“刘少爷，我错了，我不该乱嚼舌根，我该死，我该死，你把我当个屁，放了吧。”男人不停磕头道。
“传家主令，任何人胆敢在摘星楼议论苏家之事，轻则打断四肢，重则，杀无赦！”
“是！”刘家护卫齐声喝道。
“哼。”刘昀看了眼议论的众人。
“下不为例。”刘昀说完便离开了这里，身后众人仍在不停的道歉。
门外，刘昀牵住杨茜的手。
“走吧。”
“嗯。”
“苏伯父那里，你有消息吗。”杨茜道。

没有，我只知道，刚才那个人说的，都是对的，苏伯父最近确实在遣散一些下人。”刘昀摇了摇头。
二人走在大街上，杨茜的美貌引得路人纷纷回头，但看到刘昀在身旁，又连忙回过头，但总有人艺高人胆大，在看美和害怕之间选择了害怕的看美。
刘昀威胁性的回过头以示警告，那些人才若无其事的回过头。
“哈哈。”杨茜看到刘昀这般模样，不禁笑了起来。
“笑什么，这很好笑吗。”刘昀佯怒道。
“这不好笑吗，你说你心情不好，让我出来陪你散步，可结果呢，自打出来，你的那个脸啊，比之前还要差，怎么，怕我被其他人给骗走啊。”杨茜笑道。
“那还不都怨你，长的这么好看，人们都说家有丑妻，如有一宝，我看啊，我这是没有那宝贝啦。”刘昀微笑道。
“货物一经售出，概不退换，嫌我长的美，有本事当初就别死皮赖脸的抱住我强吻啊，现在后悔，晚了。”杨茜别过头也佯装微怒道。
“翅膀硬了是吧，看来晚上我要好好的重振夫纲啊。”
“哼，每次直不起腰的不知道是谁。”杨茜笑了笑，向前方走去。
“哎，等等我啊。”
……
苏家。
“老爷，两个月了。”李鹏给苏磊倒了杯茶。
“今天晚上，把所有佣人都送回去吧。”苏磊闭着眼，一脸的疲惫。
“哦对了，你也走吧。”苏磊睁开眼看着李鹏。
“我，我就算了，我一把老骨头，还跑什么，当初陪老家主打天下，如今老了，若是还能为苏家贡献点，我这条命，也算是值了。”李鹏笑道。
“李叔，你……”
“怎么，难道家主是嫌弃我太老，已经没用了吗。”李鹏微怒道。
“李叔，我没有那个意思。”苏磊皱眉道。

“家主，我这一辈子，无儿无女，在苏家待了大半辈子，苏家就是我的家。”李鹏道。
“李叔，你不懂。”苏磊摇了摇头道：“鸿成的话，点醒了我，我欠他太多，而且，说句不好听的，少卿已经废了，我要做的事，对于苏家来说是大逆不道，我无颜面对苏家众先祖，但是，为了鸿成的苏醒，这整个苏家就当是我给他的赔礼了。”
content_en:
Two months later.
The Liu family's Star Building.
"Did you hear that Su Lei bought a healing elixir at a high price from Tianbao Pavilion half a month ago? The money spent is so much that it can last me several lifetimes."
"See, this is called a trench."
"Hey, I think the Su family might be doomed."
"Don't talk nonsense, the Su family is at the peak of its power now, how can it be possible to just say it all?"
"Hey, don't believe it. Let me tell you, my neighbor's second sister's eldest cousin, his father's distant eldest nephew's cousin's cousin's godbrother, works as a watchdog in the Su family. Bah, guard. He told me that the Su family started to evacuate the servants three days ago. On the surface, it was to congratulate Su Shaoqing for going to Xuantianmen and gave them a special holiday. But in fact, Su Lei is seriously ill and will die soon."
"Ah, no, how is this possible?"
"Oh, brother, you have to believe that everything in this world can happen."
"Then tell me, is there a chance that you will die in the next second?" A hand was placed on the man's shoulder.
"Hey, brother, aren't you talking nonsense? How could I die in the next second?" The man turned his head and looked at the person who came, and immediately knelt down.
"Master Liu, I was wrong. I shouldn't have talked nonsense. I deserve to die. I deserve to die. You treat me like a fart. Just let it go." The man kept kowtowing.
"The family heir apparent has ordered that anyone who dares to discuss the affairs of the Su family in the Star-Zhaing Tower will have their limbs broken at the least, and at worst, will be killed without mercy!"
"Yes!" Liu family guards shouted in unison.
"Humph." Liu Yun glanced at the people discussing.
"It won't happen again." After Liu Yun said that, he left here, and everyone behind him was still apologizing.
Outside the door, Liu Yun held Yang Qian's hand.
"Let's go."
"Yeah."
"Uncle Su, do you have any news?" Yang Qian said.
No, I only know that what the man said just now is correct. Uncle Su has indeed been dismissing some servants recently. "Liu Yun shook his head.
The two were walking on the street, and Yang Qian's beauty attracted passers-by to turn their heads, but when they saw Liu Yun beside them, they quickly turned back. However, there are always people who are talented and bold, and choose to look at beauty in fear between looking at beauty and being afraid.
Liu Yun turned back threateningly as a warning, and those people turned back as if nothing had happened.
"Haha. "Yang Qian couldn't help laughing when she saw Liu Yun looking like this.
"What are you laughing at, is this funny? Liu Yun feigned anger.
"Isn't this funny? You said you were in a bad mood and asked me to come out and walk with you. But as a result, your face is worse than before. Why, you are afraid that I will be deceived by others. "Yang Qian smiled.
"Then it's not all my fault. You are so good-looking, but people say that if you have an ugly wife, if you have a treasure, I see, I don't have that treasure. Liu Yun said with a smile.
"Once the goods are sold, they will not be returned or exchanged. You think I am beautiful. If you had the ability, you should not hug me and kiss me so shamelessly. Now you regret it, it is too late. "Yang Qian turned her head away and pretended to be slightly angry.
"The wings are hard, right? It seems that I will have to revive my husband tonight. "
"Hmph, I don't know who it is that can't straighten up every time. "Yang Qian smiled and walked forward.
"Hey, wait for me. "
…
Su family.
"Master, it's been two months. "Li Peng poured Su Lei a cup of tea.
“Send all the servants back tonight. "Su Lei closed his eyes, looking tired.
“Oh, by the way, you should leave too. "Su Lei opened his eyes and looked at Li Peng.
"I, let's forget it, I'm an old man, why should I run away? I used to accompany my hometown to conquer the world, but now that I'm old, if I can still contribute something to the Su family, my life will be considered worthwhile. "Li Peng said with a smile.
"Uncle Li, you..."
"Why, does the master think that I am too old and useless? Li Peng said slightly angrily.
"Uncle Li, I didn't mean that. "Su Lei frowned.
"Master, I have never had any children in my life.I have been in the Su family for most of my life, and the Su family is my home. Li Peng said.
"Uncle Li, you don't understand. Su Lei shook his head and said, "Hongcheng's words woke me up. I owe him too much. And, to put it bluntly, Shaoqing is already dead. What I want to do is treacherous to the Su family. I have no face to face the ancestors of the Su family. However, for Hongcheng's awakening, the entire Su family is my apology to him." "
